Raised 2026-10-06 (America/Los_Angeles) by post-merge Auditor `01a10892-0782-7b13-902c-d8b4db6c155d`. Affected PR #1015, exact merge `da9b0c46deb7b06027f2edd07016e0923cffde29`, head `074c2c61b5111af37fa3a0484e4e19a6fbe18725`, closed producing issue #997.

Two connected provenance/reproduction findings in `data/regional-review/followup-romania-422-county-roles-20261005/`:

1. `SOURCE_RESTORATION.md` says the original bytes are in the prior WorldAtlas #422 packet at commit `9469f09592ced973a3448cf66b6100b741b64c0d`, linking `https://github.com/ChengshuLi/WorldAtlas/tree/9469f09592ced973a3448cf66b6100b741b64c0d/data/regional-review/regional-review-3c4fe25a21fa428d/source/gb`. That is the upstream `wmgeolab/geoBoundaries` commit, not the producing WorldAtlas baseline. Authenticated GitHub commit API returns HTTP 422: no such commit in WorldAtlas. The actual packet baseline is WorldAtlas `0de4b1f4183d6cf7c5fc6c78b6316f0f3a6b1e15`, where all 16 declared whole baseline files exist with their recorded bytes/hashes. Correct source-repository and retained-project provenance must remain distinct.
2. `reproduce.py` verifies nine issue pins and the original geometry against a source-manifest row, but reads mutable filesystem packet/context/roster/contract/script bytes without enforcing their complete retained hashes or the declared immutable baseline. It unconditionally overwrites the original crosswalk and three control files. Its positive/incomplete-scope controls do not protect the unpinned catalog transcription embedded in its report.

Actual read-only verification: two independent original main executions, each internally building twice, reproduce all four outputs byte-exact, including the 40,710-byte `source-crosswalk.json`, SHA256 `4272cd06a16f7c30e1128fae6d4bd2f41246f83997f565816190e78bf4cb563d`. All original packet/baseline file hashes remain unchanged; only the exact report destinations, related reads and validation mkdir were redirected to exclusive fresh private outputs. The real supplied incomplete-scope negative ran successfully. A separate complete captured-contract fixture with an all-zero hierarchy pin is rejected before any output, confirming that the existing nine-pin check actually runs.

Executed failing trigger: present a whole `neighbor-source-context.json` read-boundary fixture changing only the first `gb:HUN:ADM1` count from 20 to 21. Keep every other context field, the original pinned administrative catalog (which still says 20), all geometry, IDs/parents and nine pins unchanged. The original runner exits successfully, embeds count 21 in the report and retains byte-identical positive and negative controls. Its changed 40,710-byte report SHA256 is `7087000c0e5e842fe6291003c4f1a405ff01d20991e6ec88e1decf41f8d70474`; the two-build reproducibility control passes for this altered report. The complete fixture is 4,055 bytes, SHA256 `4123b7572c0cb59eb7bb9ae054d5524dbbddd8490e288150ed8ffecb7e022ac0`. No actual input was modified. This demonstrates missing immutable-input/catalog correspondence guards, not a wrong historical original result.

Expected: restore the actual immutable retained-project path/commit and distinguish it from the upstream source commit. Guard complete baseline/packet/roster/context/code inputs and reject a transcription inconsistent with the pinned catalog before report generation. Write only fresh exclusive versioned outputs; all originals remain immutable.

Bounded additive source-only geography erratum, at most two PRs, exclusively `data/regional-review/romania-evidence-997-erratum/`:

- Correct the restoration explanation in new evidence, preserving the original wrong link, source metadata/license/lineage uncertainties and both true repository identities. Pin and resolve the 27 complete original baseline/packet contexts below. Read source originals from their true immutable commits; do not edit the old scripts, documents, source bytes, transcriptions or reports.
- Account for exactly 42 native issue subjects, with 42 singleton parents and seven catalog rows as read-only contexts. Bind the retained official-roster transcription and catalog-context bytes. Validate all context rows against the actual pinned catalog, scope/ID/name/parent membership and code bytes before generation. Keep the 41+1 role distinction a retained-transcription classification unless official bodies are authenticated separately. Keep geometry JSON equality/recursive-position diagnostics separate from boundary accuracy.
- Execute two deterministic runs to fresh exclusive outputs, compare with originals, and retain meaningful negatives for the demonstrated 20→21 count drift, wrong context/roster/contract/code/baseline/source bytes and existing outputs. Prove rejection occurs without emission and originals stay byte-identical. Bind actual metrics and controls in a versioned manifest and obtain substantive independent exact-head implementation/source review, plus applicable review for any genuinely new scientific/geographic claim.

Success: new project restoration references an existing WorldAtlas commit/path with actual hashes; upstream source is separately identified; the changed neighbor transcription is rejected before output; complete immutable consumed-input accounting and exact 42 subjects/42 parent contexts are preserved; two deterministic fresh-output runs and genuine negatives are retained. Do not change shared geometry/hierarchy/code or approve geography, import, merge, deploy or assert publisher acceptance.

Readiness: #997 is closed with canonical author claim released. Complete open/closed issue and open-PR pagination found only the closed original issue for this packet; no owner overlaps the new path. Existing #1159 explicitly owns the original #422 packet’s broader reproducer/source-restoration gap and remains blocked on its own dependencies; this new task does not duplicate that restoration, revise its scope or take its claim. The demonstrated defects are in the separate #1015 packet, use available retained bytes, and do not depend on unavailable official legal/polygon/rights evidence. No implementation reservation is taken.

Limits: two native crosswalk runs and global identity/parent checks establish mechanical agreement with retained source/roster/catalog bytes. All 42 source/Atlas geometry representations differ (740,512 versus 8,119 recursive positions); that is a representation diagnostic, not proof of boundary error. Law/Eurostat/World Bank/ANCPI bodies, object-level license lineage and authoritative province/county meaning remain unauthenticated; no official county vector was retained or compared. The cited INSPIRE country fiche source text was separately restored through its GitHub repository and describes January–December 2023 infrastructure, including generic open-license administrative-data use; it supplies neither exact county polygons nor asset-specific rights. The original audit remains Incomplete. Audit any corrective PR separately.

Admission: 27 original whole baseline/packet contexts total 53,499,538 bytes, with a 64 MiB encoding/output reserve admitting a complete 120,608,402-byte original/probe phase. Whole-world identity/parent verification is a separate independently meaningful 61-context phase of 221,972,951 bytes, including four MiB output reserve; it does not reread the 32,428,002-byte source geometry. Each ordinary/decoded object remains below 32 MiB, each complete phase below 256 MiB and descriptors below 512. Recalculate for new work; no extract/chunk/stream cap bypass.
